notes.subject: ואחרון
notes.rationale: Bafoledi ba ganogana: 'la mafelelo/yo a latelelago' — kudu ya maina (KJV 'latter day') kgahlanong le 'la mafelelo' (JPS); mafelelo a kgutšiswa 'yo a latelelago' ka go swana le Seheberu.

notes.subject: יקום
notes.rationale: Go ema go ka bolela gore gaufi/yo a šomago — a tla ema godimo ga lerole; go se na tshwaollo ya botsogo Pele.

notes.subject: גאלי
notes.rationale: Go ka ba 'yo a duedišago mafoko a ka' — goela ke molokolodi wa lapa go ya ka molao wa boswaka.

translation: Gomme mna ke tseša gore molokolodi wa ka o phela, gomme yo a latelelago, godimo ga lerole o tla ema.
